The role-directed persona behavior preserves the security override's chain, escalation, and match-label audit surface while selecting the declared role persona; roleless and malformed/unknown-role cases remain fail-closed. The new mutating-worker seam is capability-gated against the resolved persona, with exact workflow wiring and live-table/brief tests covering both acceptance and refusal. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
